name: sales-pipeline-stage-funnel
title: Sales Pipeline Stage Funnel
description: A conversion stage funnel visualizing visitor-to-customer conversion percentages across the pipeline.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Funnel Conversion Rate Breakdown: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
